issues.description: The solution's assembleBookstore method signature does not match the template/problem expectation and is called with no arguments. The problem statement and the template's commented stub expect assembleBookstore() with no parameters, but the solution defines private static func assembleBookstore(count: Int) -> Bookstore and still calls assembleBookstore() without passing an argument. This mismatch will prevent compilation of the solution and confuses students about the expected function signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the assembleBookstore signature consistent across artifacts. Either remove the unused parameter from the solution and declare: private static func assembleBookstore() -> Bookstore { ... } (and keep the call assembleBookstore()), or change the call in main to supply the required Int argument. Preferred fix: update the solution to implement assembleBookstore() with no parameters to match the template and problem statement.
